sloka: पुष्ये जातः तु भरतो मीन लग्ने प्रसन्न धीः ।सार्पे जातौ तु सौमित्री कुLईरे अभ्युदिते रवौ ॥१-१८-१५॥
transliteration: puṣye jātaḥ tu bharato mīna lagne prasanna dhīḥ ।sārpe jātau tu saumitrī kuLīre abhyudite ravau ॥1-18-15॥

translations.english: Four worthy sons were successively born to the noble king (Dasaratha), endowed with all virtuous, resembling purvabhadra and uttarabhadra stars in brightness.
